Planning Commission Regular Meeting
PLANNING COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday MARCH 12, 2020
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Henderson, and Smith
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of February 13, 2020.
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Zoning Ordinance Amendment No. 20-001
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend Section 17.91.030 of the Palmdale Municipal Code to comply with state law regulations applicable to Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-007 recommending the City Council approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment No. 20-001 (Ordinance 1539), amending Section 17.91.030 of the PMC to comply with State law regulations applicable to ADUs and JADUs. Carlene Saxton, Acting Planning Manager
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map 63364 Time Extension No. 2
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
A request for a second three-year discretionary time extension for Tentative Tract Map 63364; a subdivision of approximately 31 acres into 101 lots for the construction of 99 single-family residences and one detention basin on two lots located at the southeast corner of 65th Street East and Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-006 approving Tentative Tract Map 63364 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Tentative Tract Map 62552 Time Extension No. 2
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
A request for a second and final three-year discretionary time extension for Tentative Tract Map 62552; a subdivision of approximately 19 acres into 57 lots, for the construction of 54 single-family residences and one detention basin on three lots, located at the northwest corner of Avenue S and 70th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-008 approving Tentative Tract Map 62552 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Clarence "Skip" Smith, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Tentative Tract Map 62553 Time Extension No. 2
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
A request for a second and final three-year discretionary time extension for Tentative Tract Map 62553; a subdivision of approximately 26 acres into 85 lots, for the construction of 83 single-family residences and one detention basin on two lots, located at the southeast corner of Avenue R-8 and 65th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-009 approving Tentative Tract Map 62553 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Clarence “Skip” Smith, Associate Planner
8D
8E. Tentative Tract Map 82364
Carlos Ramirez, Applicant
A request to subdivide approximately five acres into 16 lots for the construction of 15 single-family residences and one detention basin, located between Avenue R-8 and Avenue R-9 approximately 100 feet east of Kimberly Lane.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-011 approving Tentative Tract Map 82364 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8E
8F. Conditional Use Permit 17-008
Dani Abdulaziz, Applicant
A request by the Planning Commission to review the existing conditions and on-going operations of an amusement arcade known as Fish and Games located at 2550 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-012 revoking the Conditional Use Permit 17-008 based on the findings contained in the draft Resolution. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8F
8G. Conditional Use Permit 19-006
Raed Hawatmeh, Applicant
A request to establish an amusement arcade within an existing tenant space located at 1605 East Palmdale Boulevard, Suite H.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-005 denying Conditional Use Permit 19-006 based on the findings contained within the Resolution. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8G
9. Staff Communications
Carlene Saxton, Acting Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, April 9, 2020, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber Regular Planning Commission Agenda

Auxiliary Aids provided for Communication Accessibility upon 72 hour notice and request.
